name: Designspiration

sources.title: Designspiration homepage — 'Save & explore ideas that inspire your creativity'; signup/login, Get Pro tier, browser extension for saving images/links/notes/screenshots

requirements: Content is saved ('saves' at /save/<id>) — images, colors, links, notes, screenshots — via the browser extension or uploads
A paid 'Pro' tier exists (Get Pro) — scope of free vs pro features not fully documented publicly
The site is visual-inspiration focused — it fits design-studio/visual work, not a generic SaaS listing
preparation: Visual assets worth saving — screenshots, brand boards, imagery a designer audience would collect
workflow: Install the browser extension or use on-site saving to post images/links
Saved items get public /save/ URLs and appear in the explore feed
Discovery is by visual similarity/color search — there is no product-profile page
watchFor: Weak catalog fit — it's a visual bookmarking community, not a startup directory; a SaaS landing page only makes sense as design-inspiration content
The site is JS-heavy; without JavaScript it renders almost nothing
Outbound link value is incidental — saves link back to source pages
Traffic/community activity appeared modest in this session's fetch
countsAsLive: Saved items appear publicly at designspiration.com/save/<id> and in explore feeds
unknowns: What Pro adds over the free tier
Whether saves are meaningfully indexed by search engines
